LEGAL

Website Terms

About this website

This website provides information about Sicilia Bella Ristorante, its menus, opening hours, location, reviews and contact details. It does not currently process online payments, customer accounts or online orders.

Reservations

Reservation requests are handled directly by Sicilia Bella Ristorante by telephone or other direct contact. A reservation is not confirmed merely because a visitor has viewed or used this website.

Menus, prices and availability

We aim to keep menu information, prices and opening hours accurate. Dishes, ingredients, availability, festive offers and opening hours may change. Please contact the restaurant if you need confirmation before travelling or booking.

Allergies and dietary requirements

Online menu descriptions are not a substitute for current allergen information from restaurant staff. Please tell a member of the team about any food allergy or intolerance before ordering. Cross-contact with allergens may occur in the kitchen.

External services

This website links to third-party services such as Google Maps, Google Reviews, Instagram and Facebook. Those services are operated independently and are subject to their own terms and policies.

Website content

Website text, branding and imagery may not be copied or reused for commercial purposes without permission from the relevant rights holder.

Website availability

We aim to keep the website available and accurate, but uninterrupted access cannot be guaranteed. The website may be updated, suspended or changed for maintenance, security or operational reasons.

Contact

Questions about this website can be sent to siciliabellamgarr@gmail.com or raised by calling +356 2156 3588.
